name: plus
description: A centered plus mark with four equally sized arms in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: At the owner request, each perpendicular centerline is extended by 1 unit total, from length 13 to length 14. Endpoints move equally from 5.5/18.5 to 5/19 about the shared center 12,12. All four free ends retain radius-.85 caps at Regular 1.70. Visible native dimensions are 15.70 by 15.70, with equal margins of 4.15 units. This drawing is the construction source for X. The fill-only exterior is the exact width-1.70 union around the centerlines. The X Filled contour is obtained by rotating the entire revised Plus Filled contour, including its rounded end caps, with no independently redrawn geometry or artificial counter. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
